items.prompt: A stored vector iterator still prints a plausible value after reallocation. What should a review say?
items.modelAnswer: Do not use that output as validity evidence. Capacity-changing vector operations invalidate prior element observers, and later dereference can have undefined behavior. Reacquire valid state using current storage and stable business identity; do not run the invalid trace as a correctness test.

criteria.text: Uses documented invalidation rather than lucky bytes.
Separates business identity from an iterator slot.
Proposes reacquisition without executing invalid access.
